name: antigravity-bidi
description: Smart BiDi & RTL isolation patch for Google Antigravity (Electron & Meta Lexical)

scripts.restore: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const p = require('path'); const target = path.join(process.env.LOCALAPPDATA, 'Programs', 'antigravity', 'resources'); const backup = path.join(target, 'app.asar.backup_before_patch'); const asar = path.join(target, 'app.asar'); if(fs.existsSync(backup)) { fs.copyFileSync(backup, asar); console.log('Restored factory app.asar successfully.'); } else { console.error('No backup found at: ' + backup); }"

author: imalyzer
